description: This file defines the ClaimService class within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. It manages claim-related operations, utilizes a DAO for database interactions, and includes a method to generate a unique reference ID based on the current date and the next claim ID.

classes.name: ClaimService
classes.description: Service class providing claim-related functionalities, including generating unique reference IDs.

methods.name: getClaimDao
methods.description: Returns the ClaimDao instance, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Generates a new unique reference ID combining the current date with the next claim ID padded to 7 digits.
